checks.evidence: GTM-SB31KQ on index, product and order-confirmed.
order-confirmed.html pushes event 'purchase' with transaction_id, value and currency on the confirmation page.
No Universal Analytics and no duplicate tags in the source.
Privacy link sitewide. CookieYes and a consent mode default hold Google tags, but the Meta Pixel loads before any choice: scored as a policy link only.

findings.finding: The purchase event sends the customer's email.
findings.evidence: order-confirmed.html: customer_email:"{{customer.email}}" in the purchase push.

findings.finding: The Meta Pixel loads before the cookie banner on every page.
findings.evidence: fbq init and PageView in the head, above the CookieYes script.
findings.fix: Move the pixel into the container and fire it only after marketing consent.

findings.evidence: #newsletter form posts to /subscribe with no event.
findings.fix: Add a /subscribed page and track sign_up on it.

strengths: Google tags wait for consent (consent mode default denied).
